explanation: External-pointer tag checks are added for marking and evacuation, but major marking skips the ArrayBufferExtension when its external-pointer entry is in young space. A live buffer can then retain an extension reference after the extension has been swept.
local_verification: Built out/x64.asan/d8. The witness exited 139 with SIGSEGV on the edited build and exited 0 after temporarily restoring the upstream marking condition. The edited condition was restored and the final build repeated.
